description: Plan, apply, or restore a translation. The default is a read-only dry run.
help_translation_file: Translation JSON with embedded runtime settings
help_package_dir: Directory containing binary assets (default: JSON parent)

dry_run: Dry run only; game files were not modified.
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed. Diagnostic report: {path}
diagnostic_failed: The operation failed ({type}); the diagnostic report could not be saved.
help_help: Show this help message and exit
help_local_config: Machine-local path configuration (default: pytrtt.local.toml in working directory)
help_game_selector: Game identifier for local paths when restoring without a translation document
